extracted.summary: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Class 9 and 10) in Delhi provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying in Class 9 or 10.
extracted.amount_text: Day Scholar: INR 225 monthly plus an INR 750 annual book grant. Hosteller: INR 525 monthly plus an INR 1,000 annual book grant. A consolidated academic allowance and an extra allowance for disabled students.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have a family income of less than INR 2,50,000 per annum.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be a full-time student in Class 9 or 10 from a recognised institution.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a domicile of Delhi.
